subtitle: "Lecture 1"
author: "UAV Design Course"
date: last-modified
format:
  revealjs:
    footer: "UAV Design — Lecture 1"
    css: styles.css
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        (function () {
          // The UAV taxonomy slide (see the `.taxonomy-slide` section below)
          // embeds a full page, not slide content, so it should look like
          // the browser tab it would be if you opened that page directly:
          // no reveal.js margin gutter, footer, or slide number around it.
          // reveal.js scales the whole deck with a CSS transform on
          // `.reveal .slides`, and any transformed ancestor becomes the
          // containing block for `position: fixed` descendants (a real CSS
          // gotcha, confirmed by inspecting computed styles) — so a fixed,
          // 100vw/100vh overlay placed *inside* the deck would inherit that
          // transform and render offset/scaled instead of covering the true
          // viewport. This block runs from `include-after-body`, which
          // Quarto places as a sibling *after* the whole `.reveal` div, so
          // the overlay iframe it creates sits outside that transformed
          // ancestor chain and can genuinely cover the full browser window.
          var slideIframe = document.querySelector('.taxonomy-wrap iframe');
          if (!slideIframe || !window.Reveal) return;

          var overlay = document.createElement('iframe');
          overlay.id = 'taxonomy-fullpage-overlay';
          overlay.src = slideIframe.getAttribute('src');
          overlay.title = slideIframe.getAttribute('title');
          document.body.appendChild(overlay);

          // The overlay covers the whole window and steals keyboard focus
          // once you click into it, so reveal's own arrow-key/click
          // navigation can't reach the deck underneath — these two buttons
          // are the only way to change slides while it's showing.
          function makeNavButton(id, label, glyph, action) {
            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.id = id;
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.className = 'taxonomy-nav-btn';
            btn.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
            btn.textContent = glyph;
            btn.addEventListener('click', action);
            document.body.appendChild(btn);
            return btn;
          }
          var prevBtn = makeNavButton('taxonomy-nav-prev', 'Previous slide', '‹', function () { Reveal.prev(); });
          var nextBtn = makeNavButton('taxonomy-nav-next', 'Next slide', '›', function () { Reveal.next(); });

          function syncOverlay() {
            var current = Reveal.getCurrentSlide();
            var shown = current && current.classList.contains('taxonomy-slide') ? 'block' : 'none';
            overlay.style.display = shown;
            prevBtn.style.display = shown;
            nextBtn.style.display = shown;
          }
          Reveal.on('ready', syncOverlay);
          Reveal.on('slidechanged', syncOverlay);
        })();
        </script>
---
